lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Predict shadow size if you move an opaque cut-out farther from the torch toward the screen.

FEEDBACK
Shadow becomes smaller (typical ray model with fixed screen).

WATCH FOR
Thinking light “bends around” ordinary cardboard without a special setup mispredicts shadows.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Investigate shadow size with a torch and cut-out. Record distance vs shadow size in a table. Conclude using straight-line light ideas.

Write a short reflection naming one observation or step you corrected and why.
